field_principles.batch_api_contract: Defines result ordering, independent workload semantics, controls, and compatibility for sample_batch.
field_principles.batch_backend_ready_score: Equals 1.0 only when semantic, distributional, restart, fallback, ordering, and factory gates pass with no speed claims.
field_principles.batch_factory_receipts: Proves the production factory returns the batched-capable explicit one-axis backend.
field_principles.build_profile: Freezes release/debug and PyO3 ABI state before interpreting boundary evidence.
field_principles.checkpoint_mismatch_count: Counts checkpoint mismatches across scalar and batch runs.
field_principles.cpu_affinity: Shows scheduler placement controls used during reproduction and profiling.
field_principles.cpu_topology: Separates physical/logical core topology from any speed or hardware claim.
field_principles.distributional_parity_receipts: Records >=10000-sample n>=64 parity and multiple-comparison correction evidence.
field_principles.dominant_phase: Names the measured phase that controls the optimization hypothesis.
field_principles.energy_trace_mismatch_count: Counts energy-trace mismatches instead of burying them in a pass boolean.
field_principles.exchange_mismatch_count: Counts temperature-label exchange mismatches so retired two-axis behavior cannot reappear silently.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every Exp5738 artifact field exists before batch readiness can be trusted.
field_principles.fpga_or_tsu_used: Bare false records that no FPGA or TSU participated.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents local CPU work from becoming a board or TSU claim.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts complete: or blocked: and states whether batched backend readiness is proven or honestly null.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local CPU Rust/PyO3 one-axis batched sampling, not LLM, GPU, FPGA, or TSU inference.
field_principles.large_size_reversal_reproduced: States whether the Exp5724 Rust loss at n=48 and n=96 was reproduced under this run's preconditions.
field_principles.memory_phase_receipts: Reports peak RSS and memory-traffic proxies so allocation pressure is not hidden by aggregate time.
field_principles.optimization_hypothesis: States a falsifiable batch-boundary hypothesis or an honest null before implementation.
field_principles.parity_manifest: Lists semantic, checkpoint, restart, fallback, ordering, and adversarial controls in one replayable manifest.
field_principles.phase_timing_receipts: Attributes observed time to measurable phases before any batch-boundary edit is justified.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records release Rust/PyO3 build, CPU topology, affinity, RAM, compiler, and upstream-hash checks before measurement or optimization.
field_principles.proposal_mismatch_count: Counts proposal diagnostic mismatches across scalar, batch, Rust, and fallback paths.
field_principles.python_fallback_receipts: Proves the exact Python fallback remains equivalent for scalar and batch calls.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records replay seeds for reproduction, parity, restart, fallback, and distributional checks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the complete artifact after blanking the self-checksum field.
field_principles.reproduction_workloads: Lists the exact n=48 and n=96 workload cells used to reproduce the reversal.
field_principles.restart_mismatch_count: Counts restart suffix mismatches after checkpoint handoff.
field_principles.result_order_mismatch_count: Counts deterministic result-order mismatches for independent workloads.
field_principles.scalar_api_unchanged: Prevents batch support from mutating the existing sample() behavior.
field_principles.software_receipt: Records Python, NumPy, Rust extension, compiler, and source hashes needed to replay batch semantics.
field_principles.software_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents the batched boundary from claiming Rust/Python software speedup.
field_principles.thread_receipts: Records thread environment so scalar and batch paths share the same CPU policy.
field_principles.timing_claimed: Bare false prevents phase attribution from becoming a timing promotion.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Pins Exp5723 and Exp5724 inputs so reversal attribution cannot drift with stale artifacts.
